ENGINE AND EMISSION CONTROL
17-98
EGR SYSTEM CHECK
M1173002600058
1. Disconnect the vacuum hose (black) from the EGR valve, 
and then connect a hand vacuum pump via the Tee-fitting.
2. Start the engine. Check the vacuum condition when the 
throttle valve is opened suddenly (revving) during cold and 
hot engine conditions. If the engine is hot and the vacuum 
does not rise over 13 kPa (3.9 in Hg), perform the vacuum 
control valve check and EGR port vacuum check. Then 
continue to Step 3. If vacuum rises momentarily, proceed to 
Step 3.
When engine is cold
[Engine coolant temperature: 20°C (68°F) or less]

[Engine coolant temperature: 80°C (176°F) or more]
